steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I couldn't find any difference between the two listings.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The specs match too: the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 in graphite, with ANC, 40-hour battery and Bluetooth 5.3.

Two things to keep in mind:
- **The reviews may be shared.** Both listings show exactly 210 reviews at 4.3. That could mean the reviews belong to the product and not to either seller, so they may say nothing about how reliable each seller is.
- **The pages don't tell me about the sellers themselves.** I can't see seller ratings, how long they've been operating, or whether they're an authorized Quellwyn retailer. If you want a tiebreaker, check those things, or see whether one seller has a better track record on the platform.

If you do want to pick one, go with whichever seller has the better seller-level feedback. If you can't find any, choosing either is fine. The terms are the same, and you'd pay the same return shipping if you needed to send them back.
